data.notes: July 2026 in Split is currently anchored by Ultra Europe and its official Adriatic boat-party program; few other major July music calendars are confirmed this far out.

events.title: Ultra Europe 2026
events.summary: Ultra Europe returns to Park Mladeži in Split for three nights, with official ticketing confirming access to the Main, RESISTANCE, UMF and other stages. The event is the flagship electronic festival week in Split.

events.title: Sunburn Europe Opening Party - Boiler Club
events.summary: Opening-night Split club event for Sunburn Europe’s Croatia Yacht Week debut, bringing the Asia-rooted EDM festival brand into Boiler Club from 23:00 to 05:00.

events.title: Ultra Europe 2026 Boat Party
events.summary: The official Ultra Europe Boat Party program runs from Split’s city port across multiple departures on July 9, 10 and 11. The listing describes DJ-led electronic music on the Adriatic with house, techno and other dance styles.

events.title: Sunburn Europe Farewell Party - Central Club
events.summary: Closing Split club night for Sunburn Europe’s Croatia Yacht Week, staged at Central the Club from 23:00 to 05:00 as the branded farewell party.

events.title: Out To Sea Boat Party - July Series
events.summary: Recurring July boat-party run listed by Party Hard Travel on July 2, 5, 9, 12, 16, 19, 23, 26 and 30 at 14:00, positioned as part of Split’s summer party-package circuit.
